result.summary: The page looks largely complete, but there are a few minor visual issues: a missing icon in the bottom navigation, a truncated restaurant name, and a card that is partially cut off at the bottom of the viewport.

issues.description: The Orders tab in the bottom navigation bar has no icon above its label, while Home, Search, and Profile all have visible icons.
issues.suggestion: Add an icon (e.g., a list or receipt icon) above the Orders label to maintain consistent tab styling.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Picco...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is clipped and appears abruptly cut off.
issues.suggestion: Widen the card, allow the name to wrap, or truncate it cleanly with an ellipsis so it does not look broken.

issues.description: The second card in the 'Popular right now' section is cut off at the bottom edge of the screen, hiding its details.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding to the scrollable content area so the final card is fully visible or clearly signals more content below.
